title: UAE Condemns Houthi Attack on Saudi Arabia's Dammam Airport
detail: A headline relayed via Google News reports the UAE condemned a Houthi attack on Dammam airport in Saudi Arabia. Based on a single aggregator headline; details of the attack and damage were not available.

title: Alerts Issued in Riyadh and Najran; Coalition Says Houthi Missiles Intercepted
detail: Middle East Eye live blog reports alerts in Riyadh and Najran, with the Saudi-led coalition saying Houthi missiles were intercepted. Coalition claim; not independently verified.

title: Saudi Strike on House in Taiz Kills, Wounds Five
detail: Middle East Eye live blog reports a Saudi strike on a house in Taiz killed or wounded five people. Single live-blog report; breakdown of dead and wounded not available.
